Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: landscape editorial workplace photograph for the Employee assistance card on the Century enterprise website. Output a wide 16:9 photograph that also works cropped to a square.
Inputs: Images 1 and 2 show the woman's appearance; use them for very close visual resemblance with slight natural differences, not as compositions to copy. Images 3 and 4 are the WEBSITE PHOTOGRAPHIC STYLE REFERENCES and must govern this new image's art direction: candid people at work, a stationary subject with people moving around them, cinematic motion blur, restrained warm highlights and deep teal/olive shadows, documentary 35mm photography and fine film grain.
Create a new scene: in a busy office, viewed through a glass partition from several metres away, a woman with very similar facial features to the supplied woman is standing beside a shared worktable, reading a tablet and thoughtfully discussing work with someone just outside the frame. She wears a simple off-white open-collar shirt with sleeves casually rolled. Her light-brown, naturally voluminous curly hair is loosely pulled back with some curls around her face. Show her upper body and surrounding working environment, not a headshot. Her face is in a gentle three-quarter angle, clearly visible but she is not looking into the camera, with a quiet, natural engaged expression. Closely echo the reference woman's soft oval face, eye shape, delicate nose and subtle smile, with modest variations in cheek contour and brow shape so she is a very close lookalike rather than an exact duplicate.
Composition is environmental and cinematic: the woman's head is about 15 percent of the image height, her face is near x=55%, y=45%, her body and desk provide context. Keep her sharp enough to recognize. Place heavily motion-blurred passing colleagues at the FAR left and right edges and soft reflections on the glass; keep her face and the central square crop unobstructed. Quiet darker office architecture and glazing in the top quarter provide space for a white card heading. A laptop, a few papers and normal office furniture are natural contextual details, all unbranded with no readable content.
Match the existing website photos' subdued amber, warm ivory, olive and dark blue-green color palette and filmic contrast. Late-afternoon window light, imperfect real textures, slight underexposure, subtle grain, physically plausible long-exposure motion blur. The image should feel like an observational frame from a sophisticated enterprise documentary, with authentic activity and depth.
Avoid: posed corporate portrait, direct gaze, smile-to-camera, glamour makeup, blazer portrait, centered headshot, bright generic stock-photo office, commercial beauty lighting, pristine AI-smooth skin, exaggerated bokeh, oversaturated colors, logos, readable text, watermarks, typography, graphic overlays, extra sharp faces. No UI and no circular crop.
